evals.prompt: We're a fashion company. We know our Scope 1 and 2 but have no idea about Scope 3. Where do we even start?
evals.expected_output: Identifies material Scope 3 categories for fashion (Cat 1 raw materials, Cat 4 transport, Cat 12 end-of-life), suggests spend-based as starting method.
assertions: Identifies Category 1 (purchased goods) as the dominant category for fashion
Mentions textile-specific supply chain emissions (cotton, dyeing)
Suggests spend-based method as starting point
Offers to generate supplier data request template

evals.prompt: Ho i dati di spesa per categoria del 2024. Posso stimare le emissioni Scope 3 a partire da questi?
evals.expected_output: Confirms spend-based estimation is possible, asks for spend data format, explains methodology and uncertainty.
assertions: Confirms spend-based method is appropriate for initial estimate
Asks about data format (CSV, Excel, categories)
Warns about uncertainty (2-5x) of EEIO factors
